summary: Iteration 15 tested — Portfolio page (/portfolio) and Services dropdown pre-fill of Consultation modal both work correctly. Backend integration for featured_portfolio verified end-to-end. One functional bug found in admin folder-drawer portfolio toggle button (UI does not sync after click; consecutive clicks send the same value, breaking the second toggle).

minor.issue: Endpoint requires the FULL photo body (category, image, ...) — sending {featured_portfolio: true} alone returns 422. Not a regression, but documented for future tests: caller must merge with existing record.

ui_bugs.issue: The [data-testid^=folder-drawer-portfolio-] toggle button does NOT re-render with the new state after a click. Backend PUT succeeds and DB flips featured_portfolio, but the button caption stays on the pre-click value (e.g. shows '☆ Portfolio' even though DB is now true). Consecutive clicks send the SAME value (both PUTs contain featured_portfolio: true), so the second click does NOT toggle the flag back. Likely cause: the parent (AdminFolderManager) does not refresh the drawer's `inFolder` list after onChanged() — the child button captures `photo.featured_portfolio` from a stale prop closure. Only the 'active cover' card in the drawer header renders with fresh state.

action_items: Fix AdminFolderManager: after togglePortfolio's PUT succeeds, update the local `inFolder` list (or re-fetch the drawer's photos) so each card's button re-renders with the new featured_portfolio value. Currently only onChanged() (parent refresh) fires — the child drawer keeps stale props. A quick fix is to optimistically update the photo in local state OR key the button on featured_portfolio so React remounts.
critical_code_review_comments: ConsultationModal correctly surfaces the pre-filled service label as the FIRST <option> when it's not one of the standard three ('interiors','restoration','other'). Verified: Sound Proofing / Water-Proofing / Modernisation all show up as first option and are selected.
PortfolioPage invalidates useGallery cache on mount AND on window focus — good pattern.

PUT /api/admin/gallery/{id} requires the full pydantic model. If frontend calls sometimes send partial patches, they'll 422. The AdminFolderManager togglePortfolio correctly spreads `...photo`, so this is fine — but this API design is fragile.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (7/8 flows; admin drawer portfolio toggle broken)

seed_data_creation: None. Toggled photo 462f4335-8271-4066-a463-9c28ee7909d5 during testing; RESTORED featured_portfolio=false via API cleanup call.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 20 photos with featured_portfolio=true pre-seeded so /portfolio grid is non-empty. Passless admin login: POST /api/auth/passless-login (no body → returns {token}). PUT /api/admin/gallery/{id} MUST include full pydantic body — merge with existing record. Restoration dropdown item indices: 0=Restoration & Renovations (routes to /works), 1=Structural Renovations & Facade Renewal (routes to /works — restoration regex match), 2=Sound Proofing (modal prefill), 3=Water-Proofing (modal prefill), 4=Heritage Restoration (routes to /works), 5=Modernisation (modal prefill).
rca of the issue: AdminFolderManager togglePortfolio calls api.put + onChanged(). onChanged is the parent's refresh hook, but the folder-drawer component that renders each card's button (`FolderDrawer` or equivalent) evidently receives `inFolder` from the parent that is NOT re-computed with the new featured_portfolio value after PUT. Each PhotoCard's onClick handler closes over the initial `photo.featured_portfolio`, so both clicks compute `!photo.featured_portfolio = true` and PUT the same payload twice. Fix: after successful PUT, patch the local `photo.featured_portfolio` value in-state (optimistic update) OR ensure the drawer re-reads the updated photo from the refreshed useGallery cache.
